display.title: The Secret to Long Life: Stretching the Word Echad in the Shema
display.summary_short: Our Sages teach that whoever lengthens the word Echad in the Shema is blessed with long life, while thinking that Hashem rules everywhere.
display.summary_long: A one-minute Mitzvah Time lesson from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, part of a series on reciting the Shema. Uncle Yossi shares 'the secret to long life': our Sages teach that whoever lengthens the word Echad when saying the Shema is blessed by Hashem with long days and years. So we say Echad a little longer than the other words. How long? Long enough to think that Hashem is the Ruler and Creator way up above, way down below, and in all four corners of the world. Uncle Yossi demonstrates how to stretch the word, so children can practice saying it the right way.
display.lesson: Stretch the word Echad in the Shema and think that Hashem rules above, below and in every direction.
